title: Half of Duplex just 2 Blocks from Hadley Park!
description:
✔️ Just 3 miles from Downtown Nashville & Broadway
✔️ Comfortable family-friendly home near universities and parks
✔️ 3 bedrooms, 2 baths — sleeps up to 6
✔️ Full kitchen, Smart TV, and free parking
✔️ Great home base for exploring Music City

The space
• Sunshine Chateau is your comfortable Nashville retreat, perfectly located for exploring downtown and nearby neighborhoods
• Start your morning with coffee before heading to Broadway, Music Row, or Centennial Park
• Spend the day discovering live music, local restaurants, and Nashville attractions, then return home to relax with a movie or home-cooked meal
• Gather around the dining table after a full day of sightseeing and enjoy a relaxing evening together
• Ideal for families, couples, business travelers, and small groups visiting Nashville

🌅 Indoor & Outdoor Living
• Comfortable living room with Smart TV
• Open living and dining area designed for gathering
• Dining table seating 4
• Additional breakfast table seating 4

🛏️ Bedrooms & Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 6)
• This home includes 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms
• Bedroom 1 (Primary): King bed, ensuite bathroom; sleeps 2
• Bedroom 2: Two twin beds; sleeps 2
• Bedroom 3: Queen bed; sleeps 2
Bathrooms:
• Ensuite Bathroom: Single vanity, standing shower
• Guest Bathroom: Single vanity, shower/tub combo

🍳 Kitchen & Dining
• Full kitchen with essential cookware and serveware
• Drip coffee maker, blender, toaster, and dishwasher
• Dining table seating 4
• Additional breakfast table seating 4
• Cookware, bakeware, dishes, and utensils are provided
• Salt, pepper, and cooking oil are not provided

🏖️ What's Included
• Fresh bed linens and bath towels
• Starter supply of toiletries and paper goods
• Free WiFi throughout the home

📍 Location Highlights
• Approximately 3 miles from Downtown Nashville and Broadway
• Close to Music Row and the Country Music Hall of Fame
• Near Tennessee State University, Vanderbilt University, Fisk University, and Meharry Medical College
• Two blocks from Hadley Park with tennis courts, an indoor pool, and fitness facilities
• Minutes from Centennial Park, the Parthenon, local restaurants, shopping, and entertainment

🚗 Parking, Safety & Notes
• Two assigned parking spaces are available for guests.
• Additional street parking is available nearby on a first-come, first-served basis.
• This home is not pet friendly. If there is found evidence of an animal's presence during your stay or post check-out, guests will be charged an additional cleaning fee.
• Check-in is 4:00 PM and checkout is 10:00 AM.
